summary: An owner brings {board} three different figures for the rent a building legally allows, bills and collects.
realLife: A Tremont property submission in the 2026 record listed the legal rent roll, the lower preferential roll and still lower actual monthly collections for the same building.
gates: The case record identifies the legal roll, preferential roll and collections for matching periods.
inGame: needs: legal roll, preferential roll and collections for matching periods.

turns.what: The board can identify the gap at each stage.

turns.pulledBy: A period or unit count differs
